start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:validate-and-launch-a-subscription-app: the problem is 'I never know if I drank enough water today', the audience is office workers, the category is Health & Fitness, the store is app-store, and the competitors I know are Example Water Tracker and Example Hydrate."
no_lists_because: Its competitor notes, onboarding screens, paywall and weekly numbers are handed back in each step's answer and the person's own store and payment dashboards hold the data, so it keeps no list.
instructions: 1. Write the painful daily problem in one sentence as the people who have it would say it, who has it, the store category (for example Health & Fitness), the store to launch in first (app-store or google-play) and any competitor apps you know, up to five.

2. Say "Run workflow:validate-and-launch-a-subscription-app" with problem, audience, category, store and competitors. Step money-proof checks that apps in the category already earn and that creators already post about the problem, and stops when they do not.

3. Install the top three competitor apps, go through each onboarding to the paywall without paying and send the screenshots, one folder per app; step teardown records their beats, paywall and growth channels from your screenshots.

4. Steps onboarding, paywall and store-page write original words in the winning order of beats, an honest paywall (price, trial, first charge date, cancellation, Restore Purchases, a visible close) and a store page; approve them exactly as shown in step approve-and-submit and submit from your own developer account.

5. Steps channels and weekly plan the five growth channels and, every Monday, hand back installs, trials, paid users and revenue by channel with keep, change or stop for each; a number no dashboard gave is null and listed in no_data.

worked_examples.title: A Monday read: two paid users, one refund, one channel kept and one without data

The person's dashboards give the creators channel 120 installs, 9 trials and 2 paid users; they gave nothing for paid ads.
